verdict.rationale: Phaser ships an AI Game Agent and MCP server that build or edit games from plain-language instructions. Nothing in the evidence shows it analyzing a user's own project or data to surface insights or suggestions. The 'Surprise Me' prompt only offers random game ideas, not data-driven insights, so it does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
